facts.text: A test campaign is a planned set of test runs executed together for one purpose; campaign architecture is the overall arrangement of campaigns in time and by purpose that turns a limited window into a defensible safety claim.
facts.quote: A test campaign is a planned set of test runs executed together for one purpose, and the campaign architecture is the overall arrangement of campaigns, in time and by purpose, that turns a limited window into a defensible safety claim.

facts.text: The booklet distinguishes test campaigns by the claims they support—coverage, discovery, estimation and regression—and insists that different campaign kinds never share data.
facts.quote: The booklet distinguishes campaigns by what they can claim (coverage, discovery, estimation, regression) and insists that the different kinds never share data.

facts.text: The proposed campaign architecture divides the four-month validation window into preparation before prototype arrival, from October 2026 to mid-2027, and about 16 weeks of testing after prototype arrival.
facts.quote: After the prototype arrives, about 16 weeks run as a funnel of eight steps

facts.text: Before prototype arrival, from October 2026 to mid-2027, the program should freeze a machine-readable requirement, hazard and scenario hierarchy and build the operating-domain taxonomy and logical scenario families.
facts.quote: Before the prototype arrives (October 2026 to mid-2027): freeze a machine-readable requirement, hazard and scenario hierarchy; build the operating-domain taxonomy and logical scenario families;

facts.text: Before prototype arrival, the program should write a pre-registered statistical plan specifying claims, strata, confidence levels and stopping rules, and engage a notified body early.
facts.quote: write the pre-registered statistical plan (claims, strata, confidence levels, stopping rules); engage a notified body early;

facts.text: Before prototype arrival, the program should start shadow-mode logging on the existing warning fleet immediately and ingest years of fleet logs to estimate the operational distribution.
facts.quote: start shadow-mode logging on the existing warning fleet now and ingest years of its logs to estimate the operational distribution;

facts.text: Before prototype arrival, the program should measure braking curves, latencies, footprints and sensor positions on current machines.
facts.quote: measure braking curves, latencies, footprints and sensor positions on current machines;

facts.text: Before prototype arrival, the program should pre-build a simulator-independent scenario library, a campaign generator and automated verdict functions.
facts.quote: pre-build a simulator-independent scenario library, a campaign generator and automated verdict functions;

facts.text: Before prototype arrival, the program should build paired simulation-to-real correlation tests and hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and dry-run the tuning pipeline on the warning-only system.
facts.quote: build paired simulation-to-real correlation tests, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) rigs and a dry run of the tuning pipeline on the warning-only system

facts.text: The post-prototype testing funnel should begin with integration smoke tests and safety-envelope checks, followed by calibration using modest design-of-experiments tests and then a broad virtual campaign of combinatorial coverage across the logical space.
facts.quote: integration smoke tests and safety-envelope checks; calibration with modest design-of-experiments tests; a broad virtual campaign of combinatorial coverage across the logical space;

facts.text: The post-prototype testing funnel should search for failures around stopping boundaries, partial visibility, high closing speed, field-of-view edges and sensor degradation.
facts.quote: failure search around stopping boundaries, partial visibility, high closing speed, field-of-view edges and sensor degradation;

facts.text: Important virtual failures should receive physical confirmation, with the results used to update simulator discrepancy models rather than tune the simulation to match.
facts.quote: physical confirmation of important virtual failures, updating simulator discrepancy models rather than tuning the simulation to match;

facts.text: After freezing the final tuned settings, the program should conduct a statistical audit on the pre-declared sample without further tuning; that audit produces the detection and false-intervention claims.
facts.quote: frozen tuning of the final settings; a statistical audit on the pre-declared sample without tuning, which produces the detection and false-intervention claims;

facts.text: Any late correction during the post-prototype validation funnel should be followed by impact-selected regression testing.
facts.quote: impact-selected regression after any late correction

facts.text: Every physical run should estimate a population rate, identify a model parameter, validate simulation fidelity, confirm a boundary or satisfy a deterministic requirement; runs without an evidentiary role should not consume the validation window.
facts.quote: does it estimate a population rate, identify a model parameter, validate simulation fidelity, confirm a boundary or satisfy a deterministic requirement? Runs with no evidentiary role should not consume the window.

facts.text: The proposed validation workload includes about 6,000 zero-miss trials for 20 strata, plus hundreds of exposure hours, with an expectation of thousands of runs per night.
facts.quote: about 6,000 zero-miss trials for 20 strata plus hundreds of exposure hours, "thousands of runs per night"

facts.text: The compute needed for the proposed validation workload has not been quantified and should be budgeted before mid-2027.
facts.quote: has not been quantified and should be budgeted before mid-2027

facts.text: No published off-road program has compressed collision-avoidance validation from three or four years to under four months.
facts.quote: No published off-road program has compressed collision-avoidance validation from three or four years to under four months.

facts.text: The booklet judges the four-month collision-avoidance validation window credible only if most work happens before hardware arrival, organized according to the proposed campaign architecture.
facts.quote: The booklet judges the window credible only if most of the work happens before the hardware arrives, and the campaign architecture is the shape that work must take
